value.rationale: The claim is a complete optimal low-depth logical invariant for the classical infinite family of all finite partition lattices: exactly seven logical theories, explicit size-threshold sentences, and a sharp optimal 877-element largest smallest representative. Counting-rich automorphism orbit structure survives inside each lattice while low-depth inter-lattice logic stabilizes, providing a motivated distinction relevant to finite-model testing.
